events.verdict: Walter (TOR) firmly gets his hand on the ball during Wagner's (ORL) drive to the basket and any ensuing contact with Wagner's arm is incidental. Walter is unable to dislodge the ball from Wagner's possession and Wagner returns to the floor while both players have a hand on the ball and a held ball is correctly whistled.
Isaac (ORL) and Robinson (TOR) come together at the same spot and the head contact is inadvertent.
Isaac (ORL) is drawn into the air on the pump fake toward Walter (TOR), but lands in front of him before the start of Walter's shooting motion. The ensuing contact on the play is marginal.
Isaac (ORL) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Rhoden (TOR) briefly places an arm at Banchero's (ORL) side during his drive to the basket and the contact is marginal.
Robinson (TOR) makes contact with the ball after it has reached its apex and is on its downward flight to the rim.
Isaac (ORL) blocks the shot attempt and is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Walter (TOR) establishes himself in a screening position in Caldwell-Pope's (ORL) path and the contact is incidental as the two players come together.
Robinson (TOR) firms up in a screening position and the contact with Caldwell-Pope (ORL) is marginal.
Shead (TOR) reaches down across Banchero's (ORL) shoulder, affecting his driving shot attempt.
Robinson (TOR) is late to establish himself in a screening position in Caldwell-Pope's (ORL) path, delivering illegal contact.
da Silva (ORL) slightly grazes Walter's (TOR) arm as he extends his elbow during his jump shooting motion and the contact is marginal.
Robinson (TOR) reaches back over Carter Jr.'s (ORL) shoulder, affecting his ability to jump for the pass attempt.

After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that there are 0.5 seconds remaining on the game clock and play resumes with a jump ball at center circle. Officials triggered replay review due to a clock malfunction when the game clock ran to zero before any player makes contact with the throw-in.
